verdict.rationale: Live probes show Conductor publishes an llms.txt at its site root (HTTP 200, a structured index with a Links section) and markdown versions of its docs, such as docs.md with front-matter. Many of its doc URLs are served as .md files (e.g. /docs/api.md, /docs/api/mcp.md, /markdown/pricing), giving agents machine-readable documentation to work from. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt and markdown docs as agent-oriented resources, and independent or community corroboration of agents using them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.conductor.build/llms.txt # Conductor
Conductor is a Mac app that lets you run many coding agents in parallel on your codebase.
